mapper.sql: id, owner_id, name, description, cover_image_url, visibility, share_slug, item_count, view_count, is_removed, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_collections (id, owner_id, name, description, cover_image_url, visibility, share_slug, item_count, view_count, is_removed, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{ownerId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{coverImageUrl}, #{visibility}, #{shareSlug}, 0, 0, FALSE, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE place_collections SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, cover_image_url = #{coverImageUrl}, visibility = #{visibility}, share_slug = #{shareSlug}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND is_removed = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT FROM place_collections WHERE id = #{id} AND is_removed = FALSE

SELECT FROM place_collections WHERE share_slug = #{shareSlug} AND visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND is_removed = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_takedowns t WHERE t.content_type = 'PLACE_COLLECTION' AND t.content_id = place_collections.id AND t.restored_at IS NULL)
SELECT FROM place_collections WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND is_removed = FALSE ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_collections WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND is_removed = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE place_collections SET is_removed = TRUE, share_slug = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND is_removed = FALSE
UPDATE place_collections SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_collection_items (id, collection_id, place_id, display_name, display_note, latitude, longitude, position, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{collectionId}, #{placeId}, #{displayName}, #{displayNote}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{position}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (collection_id, place_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM place_collection_items WHERE collection_id = #{collectionId} AND id = #{itemId}
mapper.update: UPDATE place_collection_items SET position = #{position} WHERE collection_id = #{collectionId} AND id = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, collection_id, place_id, display_name, display_note, latitude, longitude, position, created_at FROM place_collection_items WHERE collection_id = #{collectionId} ORDER BY position, created_at
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_collection_items WHERE collection_id = #{collectionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE place_collections SET item_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_collection_items WHERE collection_id = #{collectionId}), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{collectionId}
